name: Rudra Oval Link Bracelet
shortDescription: Rust-brown textured ovals joined by fine warm-toned links.
description: Rudra follows a quiet rhythm of small oval centres with an irregular, rust-brown texture. Warm-toned rims frame each oval, while fine connecting links leave a little space between them. The contrast of texture and reflection gives this slender bracelet its character.
design: A single line of oval settings with raised textured brown centres and small connecting links.
finish: Reflective warm-toned borders against a rough-textured brown centre.

name: Arka Geometric Line Bracelet
shortDescription: Rose-toned geometric links frame a fine line of bright accents.
description: Arka brings a measured rhythm to the wrist. Two rows of rose-toned geometric facets frame a narrow central line of bright details, balancing clean edges with small points of light. Its repeating structure sits naturally beside a simple shirt cuff.
design: Two outer rows of compact geometric sections flanking a narrow central accent line.
finish: Polished rose-toned planes with bright pale detailing along the centre.

name: Nirav Curb Link Bracelet
shortDescription: A slim curb-link chain with a dark reflective finish.
description: Nirav keeps the familiar curb-chain form spare and precise. Flattened interlocking links create a continuous line, with pale reflections moving across the dark graphite-toned surface. Wear it alone for a quiet point of contrast at the wrist.
design: One continuous row of flattened, interlocking oval curb links.
finish: Smooth dark reflective surfaces with bright edges.

name: Tejas Chevron Link Bracelet
shortDescription: Pale chevron links trace a zigzag across a dark backing.
description: Tejas draws its character from a repeating chevron. Pale diagonal surfaces cross a dark background, creating a clear rhythm of light and shadow. Small rounded details along the edges soften the angular pattern without losing its definition.
appearanceLabel: Chevron pattern · pale and dark contrast
design: Repeating diagonal link faces with dark triangular gaps and small rounded edge details.
finish: Reflective pale faces against darker recessed sections.

name: Zaal Angular Link Bracelet
shortDescription: Warm and graphite-toned plates form a compact angular rhythm.
description: Zaal brings warm and dark tones together in a sequence of angular plates. Diagonal overlaps give the surface a layered appearance, while small rounded edge details mark the joins. Its changing planes add depth to an otherwise compact silhouette.
appearanceLabel: Angular plates · warm and dark tones
design: A single articulated-looking band of angular warm and dark sections with small rounded edge details.
finish: Softly grained warm-toned faces contrasted with dark graphite sections.

name: Ravik Crimson Weave Bracelet
shortDescription: A deep crimson woven-looking centre edged by pale links.
description: Ravik introduces colour through a deep crimson centre with a woven texture. Two fine rows of pale links frame the band, bringing a reflective edge to the softer-looking surface. The contrast feels expressive while keeping the overall line restrained.
design: A crimson woven-looking centre between two continuous rows of small pale edge links.
finish: Rich red texture with smooth reflective pale edging.

name: Ravik Indigo Weave Bracelet
shortDescription: An indigo woven-looking centre bordered by pale linked edges.
description: This indigo interpretation of Ravik pairs a deep blue woven texture with two fine rows of pale links. The linked borders give the colour a clear outline and catch the light along the edges. It offers a cooler expression of the same restrained, layered design.
design: An indigo woven-looking centre framed by two rows of small pale links.
finish: Deep blue texture contrasted with reflective pale edging.

name: Kavi Mosaic Link Bracelet
shortDescription: Warm polygon links and bright pale accents form a broad mosaic.
description: Kavi builds a broad bracelet from small repeating shapes. Warm-toned polygon links sit between rows of pale accent details, creating a mosaic with a steady, ordered rhythm. The wider surface lets the alternating tones become the focus.
appearanceLabel: Broad mosaic · warm and pale contrast
design: A broad arrangement of staggered polygon links with contrasting bright pale accent sections.
finish: Polished warm-toned faces alternating with fine bright pale details.

name: Ansh Interlock Cord Bracelet
shortDescription: Olive cord meets two warm-toned interlocking links.
description: Ansh centres on a pair of rounded rectangular links, joined together and held by muted olive cord. Small knots make the connection part of the visible design. The simple pairing of soft-looking cord and reflective links gives the bracelet an understated character.
design: Two smooth rounded rectangular links connected to olive cord with small visible knots.
finish: Reflective warm-toned links against a fine braided-looking olive surface.
